text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when Rose Kingdom and I were
passing in front of a bookstore.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...?
Hmph...
A feature on French formal gardens...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No...
I simply thought it might not be a bad
idea
to tour the lands tied to our lineage for
a while—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...What am I saying?
Right now,
I must focus on what needs to be done...
No, but still—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to fatigue,
my self-control is waning.
It might be prudent to review my upcoming
schedule.
